clauses.why: The verse says Aquila and Priscilla took him unto them, not 'aside'; the record acted together with Aquila.
clauses.english: took Apollos in and expounded the way of God to him more perfectly
clauses.ukr: прийняла Аполлоса й докладніше розповіла йому про дорогу Господню
clauses.deu: nahm Apollos zu sich und legte ihm den Weg Gottes noch fleißiger aus
clauses.spa: tomó a Apolos y le declaró más particularmente el camino de Dios

clauses.why: Only the necks laid down for Paul's life is stated; 'their own' is fine, but Paul is the speaker, so name him in the clause; citation is right.
clauses.english: laid down her neck for Paul's life
clauses.ukr: поклала свою голову за життя Павла
clauses.deu: gab ihren Hals für das Leben des Paulus dar
clauses.spa: puso su cuello por la vida de Pablo
